MB8-N7-01: withdrawn by its author after the screen return: No option set at the slot's rank 2 survives the screen for this mechanism (least product of two cards from a signed set). On a "least" stem a rank-2 key has exactly one option below it, and that option can never be a product of two cards (the key IS the least product), so the ascending plug-back the screen counts ("can Kofi get this product?") rejects option 1 and accepts the key at try 2 for every possible number set: S-R6 is structural at rank 2, not a property of these numbers. The only natural error that lands below a one-of-each-sign key is "the two numbers greatest in size, made negative", -(N1 x N2) with N2 > P1, and on x.5 cards it is always beyond the ceiling bound the pass-1 screener used, ceil(max |negative|) x ceil(max positive), so it is struck and the key is then the most negative legal option (S-R5). Scripted (returns/scratch/w-e07.mjs): 25,695 card sets of 4, 5 and 6 distinct x.5 values in [-9.5, 9.5] with both signs, seven natural errors, 4,538 rank-2 option sets passing FORM/LONE/HUB/RUN/PAIR/KEYPRINT; in 0 of them is the below-key option a product of two cards, and in 0 does it survive the ceiling bound. Rank 2 is fixed by the slot and the mechanism may not change, so withdrawn rather than forced.
MB8-N7-02: withdrawn by its author after the screen return: No option set at the slot's rank 2 survives the screen for this mechanism (divided by f instead of multiplying, got R; the intended answer R x f^2, R x f never offered). The pass-1 strike is read off the stem: multiplying by f > 1 gives a larger size than dividing by it (smaller for f < 1), so every option on the wrong side of |R| falls free. At rank 2 with a negative R the key needs two options between R and the key in size. For f = a/b > 1 the natural multipliers between 1 and f^2 are f itself (barred by the slot), 2f (only when f > 2) and a/b^2 (squares only the denominator, only when a > b^2); a/b^2 is the key divided by the printed a (PAIR), and the one natural option beyond the key, a^2/b, is the key times the printed b (PAIR). For f < 1 only one natural multiplier (a/b^2) lands between 0 and the key, and rank 2 needs two. Scripted (returns/scratch/w-e14.mjs): f = a/b for a, b in 1..9 (f != 1), R = -(w + n/d) for d 2..9, w 1..9, errors divides again, divides by f^2, doubles f, squares only the numerator, squares only the denominator: 13,122 parameter sets give exactly ONE rank-2 option set passing FORM/LONE/HUB/RUN/PAIR/KEYPRINT (the pass-1 set), and it has two magnitude strikes. Independently of the numbers, the ascending plug-back (divide an option by 3/2 twice and compare with the printed R) reaches a rank-2 key at try 2 (S-R6). Rank 2 is fixed by the slot and the mechanism may not change, so withdrawn rather than forced.
